name: Kastro
tagline: Inside Ali Pasha's walls, the best-preserved Ottoman quarter in Greece
description: The walled old town on the lake shore, holding two mosques, Ali Pasha's tomb, the silversmithing museum and a grid of stone lanes that is rare in Greece for surviving intact. It is the most atmospheric part of the city and the quietest, with the lakefront just outside the gate.
bestFor: Stays that want the walled town and the lake a few steps away
pros: Genuinely intact Ottoman quarter with the museums inside it
Lakefront promenade immediately outside the walls
cons: Visitor traffic through the main lanes

name: Lakefront and Molos
tagline: The promenade along Pamvotida, where the city walks
description: The waterfront strip running north from the castle along Lake Pamvotida, with cafes, the boat to the island and a long tree-lined promenade that is the city's main public space. Housing behind it is a mix of apartment buildings, and the whole centre is five minutes away.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting the lake walk and the cafes on the doorstep
pros: Long lakefront promenade for running and walking
Cafes and the island boat immediately there
Five minutes from the centre and the castle
cons: Busy with locals on evenings and weekends
Damp and cold in the winter months

name: City Centre and Averof
tagline: The commercial streets around the central square
description: The modern centre inland from the castle around the main square and the Averof shopping streets, holding the banks, the offices, the market and the tavernas. It is where the practical business of Ioannina happens, with the best rental supply and everything within a short walk.
bestFor: Anyone who wants the widest choice of flats and all services on foot
pros: The best rental supply in the city
All shops, banks and services close by
Bus connections to Zagori and beyond
cons: Traffic and noise in the narrow streets
Less atmospheric than the castle quarter

name: Panepistimio
tagline: The university campus district, students and cheap rents
description: The area around the University of Ioannina's campus southwest of the city, with student housing, cheap tavernas and the hospital. Ioannina has one of the highest student-to-resident ratios in Greece and this is where most of them live, which keeps rents at the bottom of the market.
bestFor: Budget stays plugged into the student calendar
pros: The lowest rents in the city
Cheap tavernas and student bars nearby
cons: Fifteen to twenty minutes from the centre

name: Perama and the Northern Shore
tagline: Past the caves, quieter housing along the lake
description: The settlement on the northern shore near the Perama caves, one of the largest cave systems in Greece, with houses and small apartment buildings facing the water and the mountains behind. It is quieter and cheaper than the city, and the drive round the lake takes about ten minutes.
bestFor: Stays that want the lake and the mountains with the city ten minutes away
pros: Lake views and much quieter than the centre
The Perama caves and walking routes nearby
cons: Ten to fifteen minutes into the city
Transport is more awkward without a car
